mechanism.claim: A large one-session VIX move opposed by the VVIX/VIX relative-convexity move is an unconfirmed volatility shock likely to be absorbed after the close; BTC should relay opposite the VIX shock for the next 24 elapsed hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: VSDAR is a magnitude-gated first-difference disagreement/absorption clock. CVACR required three-way same-sign continuation, CVSRC used static outer levels, and CTHD used static tail pressure.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: official Cboe next-session shock-disagreement timing is external to BTC activity clocks

features.absolute_vix_change_rank: strict-prior midrank over 252 valid observations, minimum 126; current appended after rank
features.adjacency: immediately previous exact common source row; no calendar fill

clock.trigger: every eligible disagreement observation; no onset filter
clock.entry: first later exact common Cboe source date at 09:35 America/New_York
clock.reservation: global half-open, entry equal to prior exit accepted

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, favorable then adverse held 5m, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no threshold, side, hold, or subset repair
